description: This file is a shell script containing a series of automated tests for verifying the behavior of Git's pack-objects command, particularly focusing on the sparse algorithm and object selection. It sets up a repository, performs various packing operations, and compares the resulting object indices to expected outputs to ensure correct functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A test helper to run a test expecting success, with a description and a block of commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the repository as part of setup.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for iteration.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for differences, commonly used to verify test results.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test suite.
